task.title: P6-010 residue: persist re-minted JWT via ResponseOptions; e2e negative control + catalog coverage; tighten InvalidToken row
task.description:
Residue from P6-010 adversarial review (2026-08-12), all polish:

1. Make the session fallback refresh genuinely once-per-idle-window: user_id_with_session_fallback (app/src/lib.rs) resolves a fresh JWT but discards it, so post-hydration server-fn calls each pay a mint round trip to Better Auth until the next document load. Persist the fresh tr_jwt via use_context::<ResponseOptions>() when the context is present (server-fn bodies have it; plain-axum callers get None and skip). The lib.rs doc comment and P6-010.md Resolution already describe this as filed.
2. e2e coverage gaps in end2end/tests/session-fallback.spec.ts: (a) no negative control — nothing pins that clearing BOTH cookies still fails closed (fallback must not have become unconditional); (b) no catalog-half coverage (/cards/:id ownership block surviving a missing tr_jwt).
3. Unit-test tightening: the InvalidToken decision-table row asserts only TryMint { .. } without checking session/original payloads (lib.rs ~:1163), unlike its MissingToken twin.
